title: Morning Bid: Failure to communicate
summary: By Anna Szymanski July 31 (Reuters) - From the Editor Hello Morning Bid readers. Three of this year's biggest market worries were on full display this week.
summary_zh: 作者：Anna Szymanski 7 月 31 日（路透社）- 来自编辑的消息 Hello Morning Bid 读者。今年市场三大担忧在本周得到充分体现。

title: Teetering US stock market faces jobs report, big earnings week
title_zh: 摇摇欲坠的美国股市面临就业报告和财报周
summary: By Lewis Krauskopf NEW YORK, July 31 (Reuters) - U.S. employment data and a batch of corporate results this coming week will keep equity investors on edge over the direction of the stock market, which
summary_zh: 作者：Lewis Krauskopf 纽约，7 月 31 日（路透社）——下周美国就业数据和一批企业业绩将使股票投资者对股市的走向感到紧张。

title: The AI spending boom is forcing a rethink on stock buybacks: One Big Investment Idea
title_zh: 人工智能支出热潮迫使人们重新思考股票回购：一个重大投资理念
summary: Stock buybacks are near historic highs. But their biggest benefit to investors — making each remaining share more valuable — is fading in the era of the AI spending boom.
summary_zh: 股票回购接近历史高位。但它们对投资者来说最大的好处——让剩余的每一股都更有价值——在人工智能支出热潮时代正在消失。

title_zh: 全球股票基金流入激增至三周高位

title: Amazon jumps as AWS growth soothes fears over rising AI spending
title_zh: AWS 的增长缓解了人们对人工智能支出不断增长的担忧，亚马逊股价上涨
summary: Amazon shares jumped more than 12% before the bell on Friday after the e-commerce and cloud giant posted its strongest cloud growth in over ‌four years, bolstering investor confidence that its multibillion-dollar AI bets are driving a ‌fresh wave of demand.
summary_zh: 周五收盘前，亚马逊股价上涨超过 12%，这家电子商务和云巨头公布了四年多来最强劲的云增长，增强了投资者的信心，相信其数十亿美元的人工智能押注正在推动新一波需求。

title: Stock market today: Nasdaq, Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq set for more gains as Big Tech's AI spending shows no sign of letting up
title_zh: 今日股市：纳斯达克、道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数将进一步上涨，因为大型科技公司的人工智能支出没有减弱的迹象
summary: Stocks were on track to end the week on an upbeat note after Big Tech earnings revived optimism in the artificial intelligence trade.
summary_zh: 在大型科技公司的财报重振了人工智能行业的乐观情绪后，股市有望以乐观的态度结束本周。

title: Tim Cook's final earnings call as Apple CEO
title_zh: 蒂姆·库克作为苹果首席执行官的最后一次财报电话会议
summary: Tim Cook delivered his final earnings call as Apple's (AAPL) CEO before passing the baton to incoming CEO John Ternus.
summary_zh: 蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 发表了作为苹果公司 (AAPL) 首席执行官的最后一次财报电话会议，然后将接力棒交给了即将上任的首席执行官约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus)。

title: Amazon Q2 earnings results beat Wall Street's estimates, as AWS continues to boom
title_zh: AWS 继续蓬勃发展，亚马逊第二季度盈利超出华尔街预期
summary: Amazon (AMZN) reported second quarter results on Thursday after the closing bell, with revenue coming in at $200.60 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $197.01 billion). Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré takes a closer look at the breaking numbers.
summary_zh: 周四收盘后，亚马逊 (AMZN) 公布了第二季度业绩，营收为 2006 亿美元（分析师预期为 1970.1 亿美元）。雅虎财经高级商业记者伊内斯·费雷 (Ines Ferré) 仔细研究了这些重大数据。
